snippet.title: Cats of Light Is Available Now on Steam | Stained-Glass Cat Puzzles
snippet.description:
The last piece clicks in, then the cat catches the light. This is Cats of Light: rotate colorful shell-like pieces, fit the puzzle together, and reveal cats in stained-glass-inspired scenes.

Cats of Light is available now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4669380/

#CatsOfLight #PuzzleGame #CozyGamess Cats
